description: Temporary use of vacant land for an art-focused food and drink market (Class E); and associated installation of single-storey timber-clad shipping containers; erection of a covered seating structure; installation of projecting screen; cycle storage; and hard and soft landscaping.

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The use of the site as an art focused food and drink  market shall be limited to a temporary period up to and not beyond three years of the date of this permission, after which point the use must cease.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-be9fc9c0-7fff-0888-99fd-94b7e18ea6f3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To allow the Local Planning Authority to monitor the use and operation of the site and in the interests of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d8354143-7fff-290f-3a66-a7730fa3ef88"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work, the applicant shall submit, and have approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, a detailed layout, cross-sections (scale 1:20), full specifications, and a detailed management and maintenance plan of the biodiverse roofs with a minimum substrate depth of 80mm, not including the vegetative mat. Further details associated with the green wall should also be submitted.</span></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d8354143-7fff-290f-3a66-a7730fa3ef88"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Reason: To reduce surface water flooding.</span></span></p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Prior to the commencement of any excavation works, a preliminary Unexploded Ordnance (UXO) risk assessment shall be undertaken. The results of this assessment, including any recommended mitigation measures, shall be submitted to the contractor responsible for Health &amp; Safety matters on and offsite. All works shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved assessment and any subsequent approved mitigation strategy.</p><p>Reason: To ensure the safety of site workers and the public, and to address potential risks associated with unexploded ordnance.</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Prior to the commencement of the use hereby approved, a noise limiter shall be fitted to the in-house music amplification system. The noise limiter shall be set at a level that ensures no noise nuisance is caused to local residents or businesses. The operational panel of the noise limiter shall be secured and tamperproof to prevent unauthorised adjustment.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason:</span><span style="font-size: 14px;"> To protect the amenities of local residents and businesses from noise nuisance.</span></p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the use hereby approved, a sound limiting device shall be installed within the premises to control all noise generated by regulated entertainment. The device shall be approved by and set to the Council's satisfaction to ensure that no noise nuisance is caused in any residential premises. The sound limiting device shall be maintained for the duration of the use hereby approved.</p><p>Reason: To protect the amenities of local residents from noise nuisance.</p>

<p>No additional noise-generating equipment associated with regulated entertainment shall be used on the premises without being routed through the approved sound limiting device.</p><p>Reason: To ensure effective control of noise emissions from the premises and protect the amenity of local residents.</p>
